data.rationale: The proposal captures the same procedure (From/To, depart date, Passengers/Class, Confirm, Show flights, select fare) with the right parameters, but it lists cabin as only Economy/Premium (the true run chose Business/First), adds trip type and a Continue step, and is somewhat vague on the fare-selection details, though a browser automation could still be built from it.
